name: Bioaqua Bamboo Charcoal to Blackhead Mask Cream 60gm
description:
Bioaqua Bamboo Charcoal Blackhead Mask Cream – 60g
Origin: Made in Korea

Product Benefits:

Deep Facial Cleansing: Effectively removes acne, blackheads, and blemishes while helping to eliminate stubborn stains and excess oil.

Younger & Smoother Skin: Moisturizes and softens the skin, removing fine facial hair to reveal a healthy, smooth complexion.

Multi-Purpose Care: Reduces the effects of computer radiation, revitalizes dull skin, and improves firmness for a more even skin tone.

Enhanced Blood Circulation: Boosts skin circulation, promoting healthier, youthful-looking skin.

Easy to Use: Simple application with clear instructions, ready for use straight out of the box.
